  1. Template for day 1 (korean) , for day 2 (English) for day 3 both English and korean.
  2. Use all your accounts. use different emails to send. Its better to have many email accounts.

Note: Remember to write your own "OPENING MESSAGE" before you copy and paste the template. please always include [TREASURE HARUTO] for example:

  1. CC Harutonations@gmail.com so we can keep track of how many emails were successfully sent

content.markdown:
# RULES AND INSTRUCTIONS

1. Template for day 1 (korean) , for day 2 (English) for day 3 both English and korean.
2. **Use all your accounts.** use different emails to send. Its better to have many email accounts.

**Note:** Remember to write your own "OPENING MESSAGE" before you copy and paste the template. please always include [TREASURE HARUTO] for example:

안녕하세요, 저희는 YGE소속 그룹 TREASURE멤버 HARUTO씨의 팬입니다. 팬으로서, HARUTO 씨 받 는 대우에 대해 의구심과 불공평함을 느꼈으며, 이 메 일을 통해 저희의 의혹을 전달하여 귀사의 진지한 고 민과 적극적인 답변을 받을 수 있기를 바랍니다.

1. CC Harutonations@gmail.com so we can keep track of how many emails were successfully sent
2. Use the hashtag of Haruto on your tweet to show that you have sent your email|
